Senior Software Engineer, Android

Summary:
Senior Android Engineer building resilient data-sync applications and TAK integrations for defense users at Ditto. Owning edge architecture, field deployment, and technical direction.
Senior Android Engineer building resilient edge-sync integrations for defense users at Ditto
Role description:
• Drive the design, development, and field deployment of applications and plugins integrating Ditto's data synchronization capabilities into warfighter situational-awareness tools
• Architect and develop performant Android applications and services for tactical end-user devices in disconnected, intermittent, and low-bandwidth environments
• Define data contracts, API boundaries, and synchronization patterns for interoperability with the TAK ecosystem and third-party systems
• Diagnose and resolve complex application, integration, and data-flow issues on end-user devices in live operational environments
• Build tooling and practices for resolving operational issues
• Mentor engineers, review designs and code, and strengthen team expertise in Android, ATAK/TAK, and integration architecture
• Partner with product and engineering leadership to define the edge integration roadmap
• Translate field usage lessons into technical insights, architectural recommendations, and product requirements
Role requirements:
• 8+ years of software engineering experience
• Strong track record building, shipping, and maintaining production applications at scale
• Full-stack comfort and deep demonstrated expertise in at least one technical area
• 4+ years of mobile application development experience
• Deep familiarity with the Android SDK, Kotlin and/or Java
• Strong integration design skills, including API contracts, data synchronization patterns, and loosely coupled systems
• Demonstrated technical leadership in architectural decisions, technical direction, trade-offs, and rationale communication
• Track record mentoring engineers through code review, design guidance, or direct coaching
• Adaptability and problem-solving ability in ambiguous, fast-moving operational situations
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• CRDT or local-first architecture experience
• Cross-platform mobile development experience involving Android and platforms such as iOS, Windows, or Linux
• ATAK/TAK ecosystem experience, including ATAK plugin development, CoT messaging, TAK Server integration, and plugin architecture
• Tactical networking familiarity, including constrained, mesh, or MANET radio networks
• Embedded databases and offline-first persistence experience with SQLite, Realm, or similar technologies
• Tactical edge deployment experience
• SOCOM, Department of Defense, or federal customer experience
• Technical lead experience on a small team or complex cross-functional initiative
• Backend or systems development experience with Go, Rust, or Python
Benefits:
• Competitive salary
• Meaningful equity
• Health insurance
• Dental insurance
• Vision insurance
• Life insurance
• Disability insurance
• 401(k)
• Flexible spending accounts
• Flexible time off
• Remote work
• Atlanta office available as an optional place to work or meet with teammates
Tech stack:
Android, iOS, Java, Kotlin, Linux, Python, Realm, Rust, SQLite, Go
